systems.name: GeneralTools
systems.function: A Kotlin Multiplatform library of generic helpers: Color, 2D geometry and small string, list and timing utilities in common code for the JVM, JS and Wasm/JS, with file, URL and desktop-automation helpers on the JVM only, built and published as one artifact by one Gradle build.

systems.name: Gradle build
systems.function: Build, test, check and publish the library as one Kotlin Multiplatform module: the wrapper, the settings, the root build script with the targets and compatibility configuration and the API proof harness, the committed Yarn lock, and CI running ./gradlew build on every push.
systems.toolchain: Gradle 9.0.0 · Kotlin 2.4.21, language and API 2.2 · vanniktech maven-publish 0.37.0 · foojay toolchain resolver 1.0.0 · Java 17 toolchain

systems.name: Failure and logging seam
systems.function: Give every file one logging API and report every expected failure the same way: the internal KLogger.failure helper logs one WARN line on the calling file's own logger and returns a Result.failure carrying an IllegalArgumentException with the same message; the common code obtains its loggers from kotlin-logging under their 2.x names.

systems.name: Geometry value core
systems.function: The mutable coordinate-pair value types TwoDoubles, Point and Dimensions with their equality contract, subclassing behind an opt-in marker, and the import-gated arithmetic operators of com.spartanlabs.geometry.arithmetic, the first Supported Extension.

systems.name: Box model
systems.function: One shape contract for axis-aligned rectangles, AxisAlignedBox with its primitive accessors and operator contains, in three storage forms, the mutable Rectangle, the ImmutableRectangle copy and CenteredBox, and the conversions between them.

systems.name: Geometry queries
systems.function: Vector algebra on Point, Segment, Ray and the segment and ray intersection tests against segments and boxes, with NaN-safe slab arithmetic and every failure reported through the failure seam.

systems.name: Color
systems.function: The validated RGBA value type Color, every channel in 0..255, with its transforms (lightened, darkened, inverted, grayscale, lerp, withAlpha), its luminance, the clamping factory Color.of and its codecs to and from hex strings, packed ints and normalized floats.

systems.name: Misc helpers
systems.function: The small general helpers on the one JVM facade MiscKt, split by what they need from the platform: string, list, timing and Result helpers in common code, and asURL, read and the slf4j Logger.time extension on the JVM.

systems.name: Desktop edge
systems.function: Drive a desktop from the JVM: screenshots of the screen, an area or a browser page, opening a page in the browser, and cropping and saving images, through AWT, ImageIO and commons-io, on the facade UserActionsKt.

systems.name: Test suite
systems.function: Prove each system's behaviour on every target it ships on, organised by named test set: the pure tests in commonTest run on the JVM, JS and Wasm/JS, the JVM-only tests in jvmTest, each class in com.spartanlabs.testing.<set>.<package>.

systems.name: Target and compatibility configuration
systems.function: A part of the Gradle build: what the module compiles for and against, the jvm, js and wasmJs targets, the Kotlin language and API pin 2.2 with the published kotlin-stdlib 2.2.0 requirement, the dependencies of each source set, the -PtestLevel test-set filter on every test task, and CI on Temurin 17.

systems.name: API proof harness
systems.function: A part of the Gradle build: the public API of every target as a reviewed, committed artifact, the JVM and klib dumps under api/ that checkKotlinAbi in check compares and updateKotlinAbi rewrites, with explicitApi() so a declaration is public only on purpose.

systems.name: Version catalog
systems.function: Hold the version of every dependency and every plugin once, in gradle/libs.versions.toml, read by the module and root scripts, the convention plugins and build-logic's own build.

systems.name: Build logic
systems.function: Hold every piece of build configuration more than one module needs once, as convention plugins in an included build: the publishing, multiplatform-library, JVM-library and test-set conventions and the shared constants.

plannedBy.placement: build-logic/, an included build brought in through pluginManagement

systems.name: Java floor
systems.function: Make 17 the oldest Java release every JVM artifact runs on, state it once, and fail check through verifyJavaFloor when the built output or its dependencies break it, with no toolchain requested.

plannedBy.placement: build-logic: one constant, one registration entry point and the guard task

systems.name: Module layout and published shape
systems.function: Decide which code ships in which artifact and what a consumer's build resolves: the GeneralTools-core and GeneralTools-desktop modules and the source-less GeneralTools umbrella over both, one version, the rewritten root POM, the dependency constraint and the module-path names.

plannedBy.placement: three Gradle modules, each in a folder named after it, and the settings file

systems.name: API reference jars
systems.function: Ship each published component's API reference as its javadoc jar, from Dokka 2 with failOnWarning, the root aggregating the library modules, guarded by two page-count checks.

plannedBy.placement: the publishing convention, each library convention, the umbrella's script and the root script

systems.name: Publication proof and release set
systems.function: Prove the published shape before anything is uploaded and make an upload hold the whole set or nothing: the publication comparison, the rehearsal repository, the release set of three modules and the component-set assertion.

plannedBy.placement: the publishing convention and the root script
